reproduction: Authenticate and open the Radar with no previously loaded stats, or let the stats request fail while the opportunity request succeeds.
Observe an opportunity whose decision_score and score are both absent/unknown.
Open the opportunity detail and observe the score presentation.
observed_result: Stats renders missing values through `v ?? 0`, presenting unknown/unavailable counts as zero.
Opportunity card renders missing decision_score/score as `0/100`.
Opportunity detail renders missing decision_score/score as `0/100`.
expected_truth: Missing or unavailable statistics remain visibly UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE and are never presented as measured zero.
Missing scores remain visibly UNKNOWN/NOT SCORED and are never presented as an actual 0/100 score.
A failed stats request must not create the customer interpretation that there are zero opportunities/open/high-relevance items.
required_retest: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: mobile source regression rejects missing-to-zero fallbacks for customer-facing stats and scores.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE or READY_FOR_DEVICE: network/stats failure preserves last known values with stale/error disclosure, or UNKNOWN when no prior truth exists.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE or READY_FOR_DEVICE: unknown opportunity score is rendered without numeric false precision.
hard_boundary: Golden Path owns acceptance and regression only. Mobile implementation repair belongs to MOBILE_PRODUCT_OWNER.
